title: Volnus Prime
extract:
Volnus Prime is the primed variant of  Volnus, with improvements to its damage, critical chance, critical multiplier, and status chance. Volnus Prime was released alongside  Gara Prime and  Astilla Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Volnus for the fastest attack speed of all hammers.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On March 15th, 2022, Volnus Prime, along with  Gara Prime and  Astilla Prime, entered the Prime Vault and were retired from the reward tables. Any preexisting components or fully-built items will remain as is.

Notes
As a Signature Weapon, Volnus Prime gains a bonus effect with  Gara or  Gara Prime, gaining 100% additional radial slam attack damage.

Trivia
Volnus is derived from the Latin word vulnus, which means "wound" and is the origin of the word vulnerable.
This may be a reference to the weapon's high proportion of  Slash damage.
Upon performing a slam attack, glass shards will fly out from the point of impact. This is purely a visual effect.

Bugs
The Follow Through decreases from 60% to 40% when equipping a stance mod. Practically speaking, the follow through is currently the same as all other hammers.
